The body run arrives on every leg; none is walked over 30 per cent, 0.076 of all legs (m6-dungeon-run-share, closed in M6 7 F, on the east half's legs); the leg's stop rules are the Temple 40+ profile's (stop within 1.0 m, dwell 0.25 s, a leg at most 90 s), not measured on this ground

sources.vendors: the outskirts profile's Holtburg rows verbatim (four, and since M6 14 Monyra the Jeweler's, below) in guid, cell, point, stop_cell, stop_point, buys_item_types and buy_price (holtburg-outskirts.json sources.vendors gives the stops and the price rule, the pinned world SQL v0.9.296, price = max(1, ceil(1.35 x Value - 0.1)), Vendor.cs 577-585 @95ef426d), as the Temple 20-40's rows, with the 'sells' lists cut to the wares this profile uses (M6 3 F3 adds Cindrue's account-formula wares, each her create-list row, see components) (the loader refuses a ware that is no stock line, gear floor ware or trade note): Archmage Cindrue 2304 sells the Copper Scarab 686 (Value 100, 135) and the Prismatic Taper of the stock, the Wand 2472, the four Mana Charges and the Trade Note (10,000) 2625 the purse lists (her other nine notes are not listed: the sells-equal-the-draft check prices a trade note at ACE's 1.15 only for a purse note); Thelnoth Cort the Healer 715 the Mana Potion 379 (230); Ecutha the Tailor 719 the Faran Robe with Hood 5851 (68); Shopkeeper Renald the Elder 718 buys the drops. Oolutanga's Refuge's Mage 22721 and Healer 22725 are the island's shop: TODO(m6-island-vendors), item 4's, never added as vendors here (D48) Shopkeeper Renald the Elder 718 also sells the Leather Gauntlets 56 (Value 1,100, 1,485 pyreals; armour level 130, burden 270, ValidLocations 0x20, ClothingPriority 0x8000, no wield requirement; his create list holds it in the pinned SQL): the gear floor's hand armour (M6 7 AH: a corpse run's replace step buys it when no worn piece covers the hands). M6 8 D (m5-side-packs-use, m5-pack-short): the Pack row of Shopkeeper Renald the Elder: SELECT weenie_Class_Id FROM weenie_properties_create_list WHERE object_Id = 718 AND destination_Type = 4 AND weenie_Class_Id = 136 (one row, the world SQL v0.9.296); weenie 136 is a Container (ItemType 0x200, ItemsCapacity 24, PropertyInt 19 'Value' 65); price = max(1, ceil(1.35 x 65 - 0.1)) = 88. M6 14 (m6-purse; live 2026-11-12: a level 39 mage's main pack stood full of rings, bracelets, necklaces and gems, the sale named each one outside every listed mask and the loot rule then left every corpse for want of a free slot): Monyra the Jeweler 716 is the outskirts profile's fifth Holtburg row verbatim (holtburg-outskirts.json: guid 0x7A9B4020, cell and stop_cell 0xA9B40117, Archmage Cindrue's entry hall, point (157.19, 135.298, 66.12), buys_item_types 0x00040808 = Jewelry 0x8 + Gem 0x800 + PromissoryNote 0x40000, buy_price 0.9, no 'sells': a loot buyer only): SELECT li.guid, HEX(li.obj_Cell_Id), li.origin_X, li.origin_Y, li.origin_Z, i.value, f.value FROM landblock_instance li JOIN weenie_properties_int i ON i.object_Id = li.weenie_Class_Id AND i.type = 74 JOIN weenie_properties_float f ON f.object_Id = li.weenie_Class_Id AND f.type = 37 WHERE li.weenie_Class_Id = 716 (one row: 2056994848, A9B40117, 157.19, 135.298, 66.12, 264200, 0.9; a SELECT on the world copy, 2026-11-12). Her MerchandiseMinValue (int 75) is 0 and her MerchandiseMaxValue (int 76) 1,000,000, and ACE's sale reads neither (Player_Commerce.cs VerifySellItems 232-298 @95ef426d: the mask, IsSellable, Retained, a Value of 1 or more, an empty container). Novedion the Gem Seller 9423 (outdoors at (124.79, 31.52, 94.01), mask 0x808, MerchandiseMaxValue 25,000) is not listed: Monyra's walk is the one the dat tests confirm (VendorStopConfirmDatTests and ResupplyRouteDatTests walk every vendor of the den's profile, hers among them) and the outskirts, the Burrow and the Lodge list her already. M6 14 grocer (the owner, 2026-11-13: sell the empty flasks; live 2026-11-13 04:54 UTC: the supply trip named every Empty Flask outside Monyra the Jeweler's mask and kept it): Fispur Ansel the Grocer 714 (holtburggrocer) is the outskirts profile's row verbatim (holtburg-outskirts.json: guid 0x7A9B4024, cell and stop_cell 0xA9B4016A, his shop, point (78.9714, 38.5313, 94.005), buys_item_types 0x00446220 = Food 0x20 + Container 0x200 + Writable 0x2000 + Key 0x4000 + PromissoryNote 0x40000 + CraftCookingBase 0x400000, buy_price 0.9, no 'sells': a loot buyer only): SELECT li.guid, HEX(li.obj_Cell_Id), li.origin_X, li.origin_Y, li.origin_Z, i.value, f.value FROM landblock_instance li JOIN weenie_properties_int i ON i.object_Id = li.weenie_Class_Id AND i.type = 74 JOIN weenie_properties_float f ON f.object_Id = li.weenie_Class_Id AND f.type = 37 WHERE li.weenie_Class_Id = 714 (one row: 2056994852, A9B4016A, 78.9714, 38.5313, 94.005, 4481568, 0.9; a SELECT on the world copy, 2026-11-13). The Empty Flask (wcid 7940 flasksimple, ItemType 0x400000 CraftCookingBase, Value 1, MaxStackSize 1, so each one takes a slot; one is left by each potion she drinks, about 13 an hour) is in no other listed vendor's mask; ACE pays max(1, floor(0.9 x 1 + 0.1)) = 1 pyreal a flask (Vendor.cs GetBuyCost 591-599 @95ef426d). His MerchandiseMinValue (int 75) is 0 and his MerchandiseMaxValue (int 76) 1,000,000, and ACE's sale reads neither (Player_Commerce.cs VerifySellItems 232-298 @95ef426d: the mask, IsSellable, Retained, a Value of 1 or more, an empty container). Every other type of his mask is also Shopkeeper Renald the Elder's (0x480467A7), so he is listed after Renald: a tie of the loot buyers' counts goes to the profile's earlier row (ResupplyPlanner.LootBuyers), and that stays Renald. Her drinks (the Mana Potion 379, the Potion of Healing 377, the Health and Mana Tinctures 27319 and 27322) are Misc 0x80, outside his mask, and the sale keeps every drink she uses whatever a mask takes (ResupplyRun.DrinkInUse, m6-sale-keeps-drinks); a pack (Container) and a trade note are never offered (ResupplyRun.SaleItems). His stop is his own cell as Thelnoth's, Ecutha's and Monyra's are (the station's request stops ShopLeg.UnseenVendorReachMetres short of his point): the dat tests walk every vendor of the den's profile from Holtburg's lifestone, his leg among them (ResupplyRouteDatTests: the room graph's path, about 32 m, enters his shop through the room 0xA9B4016E and ends in 0xA9B4016A; VendorStopConfirmDatTests: the walker's pre-check confirms it and his point stands on the floor through the statics, and The_stations_walk_from_the_lifestone_to_the_Grocer_enters_his_shop_and_passes_the_pre_check plans the station's own request, his point with that range); the shop's two doors (0x7A9B401E and 0x7A9B401F, world objects the dats do not hold) and his body are not in those tests, and the walk to him has not been run live (TODO(m6-grocer-stop-point)).
sources.spell_plan: M6 3 p2, from the ladder rung 'abode' (ladder/war-mage.json, spell_level 4-5, element fire; M6 3 F1, 3-R2: the rung starts at 41, the Temple 20-40's portal ends at 40) and D41: character level 41 casts Flame Bolt IV (base 240: IV at 0.95, V needs 243); levels 42-59 cast Flame Bolt V (base 243 at level 42 and 281 at level 59: V at 0.95, VI needs 293). The crossing levels are SpellPlan.LevelAt (Mage/SpellPlan.cs) over SpellPlan.ProjectedWarBase at plan_cast_chance 0.95, read for every level 40 to 126 in M6 3 p2 (level 41 base 240 is IV, 42 base 243 is V; 66 base 291 is V, 67 base 293 is VI; 122 is VI, 123 base 343 is VII; the skill a level needs is its power + 43: V 243, VI 293, VII 343); two rows, in the rung's band. M6 14 (the owner, 2026-11-13: the Temple 20-40 leaves the ladder, the Cave to 39, the Abode from 40; the Abode's kit to the Cave's standard): the IV row starts at 40 with the rung's band, read again on the planner of M6 item 14 (SpellPlan.ProjectedWarBase): 40 base 237 and 41 base 241 are IV, 42 base 245 is V, 59 base 280 is V (VI needs 293). The rows are the base skill's projection: in the level up job's fight the ladder's live cap governs and these rows do not lower it (FightOptions.LiveCap; war-mage.json sources.plan_cast_chance); every other fight here keeps them as its cap M6 14 (D135, the owner, 2026-11-13: the Abode from 25 on Flame Bolt V): the IV row starts at 25 with the rung's band: 27 base 193 is IV, and 25 and 26 (185 and 188) are III on the base skill, a level this ground's kit does not carry (components IV to VI), so the row names IV, the lowest level it carries; the ladder's fight casts by the live cap on her buffed War Magic, which the buff bot lifts about 60, to V at 25 (D129), and no row lowers it.
sources.components: M6 3 F1: Flame Bolt IV (level 41) is 1 Silver Scarab and 3 Prismatic Taper, the Temple 20-40's line (Silver Scarab 688 joins the stock and Cindrue's wares at 338, as there); the foci formula, as the Temple 20-40's (GearKit.FociFormulaCounts over the dats' Flame Bolt formulas; HuntingGroundDatTests.A_dungeons_components_cover_the_war_lines_formula_at_every_spell_level_its_plan_names pins the foci formula): Flame Bolt V (spell 84): 1 Gold Scarab and 4 Prismatic Taper. M6 3 F3 (3-R10, closes TODO(m6-dungeon-account-formula)): the account formula of 'test' (SpellFormulaRules.CustomizeForAccount, read from the dats; what Winnie casts if she loses her Foci of Strife, HasFoci, Player_Spells.cs 458-488 @95ef426d) is carried beside the foci formula, as the outskirts carry it (holtburg-outskirts.json sources.components), for each spell level of the plan, pinned by HuntingGroundDatTests.A_climbers_dungeon_carries_the_account_test_formula_beside_the_foci_formula: IV (spell level 4): Silver Scarab, Pink Taper, Hawthorn, Blue Taper, Powdered Onyx, Turpeth, Birch Talisman; V (spell level 5): Gold Scarab, Orange Taper, Hawthorn, Indigo Taper, Powdered Onyx, Turpeth, Red Taper, Birch Talisman. Every coloured taper, herb, powder and talisman is a row of Archmage Cindrue's create list (weenie 2304, weenie_properties_create_list, destination 4, the pinned world SQL v0.9.296; Value 25 tapers, 10 Hawthorn, 5 the powder, Turpeth and Talisman; price = max(1, ceil(1.35 x Value - 0.1)): 34, 14, 7); the scarabs are the foci formula's lines above. Carried, no Holtburg vendor sells them (not in 2304's create list): Gold Scarab, TODO(m6-island-vendors). M6 14 (the owner, 2026-11-13: the Temple 20-40 leaves the ladder, the Cave to 39, the Abode from 40; the Abode's kit to the Cave's standard): level VI's formulas, the Quarters' rows (tusker-quarters.json components): the foci formula, Flame Bolt VI (spell 85): 1 Pyreal Scarab and 4 Prismatic Taper; the account formula VI: Pyreal Scarab, Yellow Taper, Hawthorn, Violet Taper, Powdered Onyx, Turpeth, Indigo Taper, Birch Talisman. No plan row names VI (the base skill reaches 293 only at 67); the level up job's fight casts it by the live cap (FightOptions.LiveCap) when her buffed War Magic lands it at 0.95, and the fight's own check skips it while the pack lacks a component. The Pyreal Scarab is the town stock's (Uziz); the Yellow Taper 1653 and the Violet Taper 1651 are Archmage Cindrue's (create list rows, Value 25, 34 pyreals) and stock lines.
sources.supplies: M6 3 p2, sized from the rung 'abode' as the outskirts profile was (holtburg-outskirts.json sources.supplies): the modelled rate is twice the move-on floor, 172 kills an hour, at the move-on ceiling of 7.3 casts a kill (ladder/war-mage.json) = 1256 casts an hour, all of them Flame Bolt V as the worst case, 4 Prismatic Tapers a cast on the foci formula = 5024 tapers an hour. Prismatic Taper 20631 (Archmage Cindrue, 30): keep 850 = 10 minutes of that burn (837) rounded up to 50 (capped at 1,000, a stack's limit; 6 burden each, and the capacity is the climber's Strength, TODO(m6-climber-strength)), trip_under 300 (a third of the keep rounded up to 50), stop_under 5 (a cast needs 4). Scarabs: Gold Scarab 687 (the only spell level here) is CARRIED: no Holtburg vendor sells it (Cindrue's wares in the draft's town half end at the Silver Scarab), so the line has no vendor, keep 20, trip_under = stop_under = 2 as the Black Spawn Den's carried lines (D8): a stack under 2 stops the loop by name; where the climber buys it is TODO(m6-island-vendors), item 4's; no spell here burns more than ComponentLoss 0.05 x CDM 0.1 = 0.005 a cast (Flame Bolt II's 0.05, Spell.TryBurnComponents, Spell.cs 157-189 @95ef426d; III to VII unmeasured, TODO(m6-component-loss-iii-v)), so 20 scarabs last 3.2 hours at 1256 casts an hour. The Copper Scarab 686 is on every spine profile at keep 20, trip_under 5, stop_under 2 (the Temple 40+'s line): the four travel spells (Lifestone Recall and Tie, Primary Portal Tie and Recall) burn one a cast on the foci formula, and GearKit.CastBurns refuses a ground that cannot buy it (GrantsCountedTests). Mana Potion 379 (Thelnoth, 230): keep 5, trip_under 2, stop_under 0, the outskirts' reserve. One restock from nothing at these keeps is 29,350 pyreals at the vendors' prices (850 Prismatic Tapers at 30 = 25,500; 20 Copper Scarabs at 135 = 2,700; 5 Mana Potions at 230 = 1,150); purse: coin 30,000 (that rounded up to 1,000, the floor the coin is kept at as the outskirts' is), notes of min_note 10,000 and up (the surplus is kept as bonded notes: a death takes half the coin and no note, Player_Death.cs:347-360 @95ef426d), the one note listed is the outskirts' placeholder count 1 (TODO(m6-purse-note-count)). kit: none, as the outskirts' and the Temple 20-40's (a kit line would put the ground into the level-80 buff-kit checks of GrantsCountedTests and MageBuildScenarioTests); the floor's Wand and Faran Robe with Hood stay sold by Cindrue and Ecutha for GearFloor; burden_trip_percent 150 as the outskirts'. M6 3 F3: the account formula's lines (herbs, powders, talismans, coloured tapers) are stock lines at keep 2, trip_under 2, stop_under 2, the outskirts' rule for them (holtburg-outskirts.json sources.supplies): a backup the focus-holding climber does not burn, a rung's cost of about 250 pyreals the first restock, inside the purse (see components) M6 item 14 (m6-goldscarab): the Gold Scarab 687 is no carried stock line any more: it is the town stock's, bought at Uziz on the way out with the Pyreal Scarab 690 (the town_stock section gives the seller, the price and the sizing); nothing of it stops the run. M6 14 (the owner, 2026-11-13: the Temple 20-40 leaves the ladder, the Cave to 39, the Abode from 40; the Abode's kit to the Cave's standard): the Cave's drinks and scarabs: Potion of Healing 377 (Thelnoth Cort the Healer; BoostValue 25 on Health, Value 170, 230 pyreals): keep 30, trip_under 6, stop_under 0, listed before the Mana Potion so a short trip budget fills it first, the Cave's sizing (tusker-cave.json sources.supplies: a drink of 2.5 s is 10 health a second, a way out of 20 to 30 s is 8 to 12 drinks); the Mana Potion 379 keeps 100, trip_under 10 (it was 5 and 2), the Cave's: the fallback to the Mana Tincture of the town stock, 2,500 mana; the Silver Scarab 688 keeps 20, trip_under 5 (it was 10 and 3, a lower level's line), the Cave's cap-level line: besides Flame Bolt IV at 40 and 41 it is burned by the level IV item spells her pass keeps on her armour, Impenetrability, Bludgeon Bane and the six other banes (war-mage.json sources.vitals, m6-banes: about 25 s and eight casts a pass); the level VI account formula's Yellow Taper 1653 and Violet Taper 1651 at keep 2, trip_under 2, stop_under 2, the account lines' rule. The Health Tincture 27319 and the Mana Tincture 27322 are the town stock's (Ludora the Healer, Dryreach), the Cave's rows. One restock from nothing at these keeps is 65,406 pyreals (850 Prismatic Tapers 25,500; 20 Silver Scarabs at 338, 6,760; 20 Copper Scarabs 2,700; 30 Potions of Healing 6,900; 100 Mana Potions 23,000; the eleven account lines 546), so the coin is 66,000 (that rounded up to 1,000; it was 30,000), the note as before.

jumps.name: pit 0x5C4502A9
jumps.source: M6 14 pits (the owner, 2026-11-13: TODO(m6-abode-pits) built). The dats: the pit 0x5C4502A9 is a 10 by 10 m shaft (x 125 to 135, y -65 to -55) with no floor polygon, open from z 6 down past the bridge 0x5C45010C at z -12 (x 128 to 132) to the floors of 0x5C45010F and 0x5C450110 at z -18; its east doorway (x 135, y -65 to -55, z 0 to 6) opens from 0x5C4502B9 and its west doorway (x 125) onto 0x5C4502A0, both floors at z 0, so the gap is 10.0 m brink to brink on every line across; the jump takes the middle, y -60, 5 m from each wall (the doorways are 6 m tall, the jump's apex 2.7 m). The run-up is 4 m back from the brink and the landing 1.5 m past the far one. need_m 10.75: the client's own physics (the offline walker: get_leave_ground_velocity 11.6096 0x00528CD0, get_jump_v_z 0x005286B0, the edge slide 0x0050BEA0), run up, held at the brink by the edge slide and let go with a full bar by the runner itself (NavRunner.Jumps), lands on the far floor from a level-ground flight (JumpReach) of 10.06 m (Run 103, Jump 130) and up, catches the far brink and stays in the pit cell at 9.70 m (Jump 120: jump-short) and falls in at 8.86 m (Jump 98: jump-fell) (PitJumpDatTests.The_need_is_a_flight_that_lands_and_shorter_jumps_fail_by_name); the 0.69 m over the shortest landing is Lifestone's margin. Qwinnie at level 47 flies 11.54 m with the buff bot's level VII set (Run 103: Quickness 15 + 40, 8 ranks, Sprint + 40; Jump 178: Strength 75 + 40 and Coordination 105 + 40 over 2, 8 ranks, Jumping Mastery + 40; the shard's biota_properties_attribute, _skill and _enchantment_registry, read-only, 2026-11-13) and 5.88 m bare (Run 23, Jump 98), which falls into the pit. A jump lands at its take-off's vertical speed (7.3 m/s), under ACE's falling-damage floor of 15.75 m/s (Player_Move.cs:247-276 @95ef426d): no damage. The Tusker Holding (0x5B48) is the same layout.

town_stock.name: Health Tincture
town_stock.source: M6 14 (the owner, 2026-11-13: the Temple 20-40 leaves the ladder, the Cave to 39, the Abode from 40; the Abode's kit to the Cave's standard): the Health Tincture 27319 of Ludora the Healer 2229 of Dryreach, 775 pyreals, the Cave's line of the same ware (tusker-cave.json town_stock: the seller, her create list and SellPrice 1.55, the SELECTs on the world copy, and the stop on the way out from the Town Network, network-to-dryreach and dryreach-to-network, travel-routes.json). keep 12 and trip_under 6 are the Cave's sizing: a tincture a drink of 2.5 s is 20 health a second, the one drink that out-heals a pack (the Cave's 8 to 11.6 health a second, which the Redeemer's hit 82 over the Crimsonback's 65 makes 10.1 to 14.6 here); a stand of 20 to 30 s takes about 6. The Abode's own rate is not measured (TODO(m6-abode-fight-live)); the walk from the drop to her is not walked live yet (TODO(m6-town-stock-live)).

town_stock.name: Mana Tincture
town_stock.source: M6 14 (the owner, 2026-11-13: the Temple 20-40 leaves the ladder, the Cave to 39, the Abode from 40; the Abode's kit to the Cave's standard): the Mana Tincture 27322 at the same counter, 775 pyreals, the Cave's line of the same ware (tusker-cave.json town_stock). keep 30 and trip_under 10 are the Cave's sizing: the Cave drank about 4,000 mana an hour on 2026-11-11; 30 tinctures are 1,500 mana and the 100 Mana Potions of the home walk 2,500, a stretch between trips and two thirds of the next. A kill here costs 74 mana before Mana Conversion (the fight section) against the Cave's 33 (tusker-cave.json fight), and the modelled 172 kills an hour against the Cave's 224 (twice the move-on floors, war-mage.json) make about 12,700 mana an hour before Mana Conversion against the Cave's 7,400, so the Abode's drink is likely higher than the Cave's: not measured (TODO(m6-abode-fight-live)). The burden: 30 x 50 + 100 x 15 + 12 x 50 + 30 x 15 = 4,050 for the four drinks, as the Cave's.

town_stock.name: Gold Scarab
town_stock.source: M6 item 14 (m6-goldscarab): the Gold Scarab 687 of level V at Archmage Sammam al-Ashiz 1824 of Uziz, 775 pyreals: the seller, the read-only SELECTs, the walk from the Network drop and back (TownNetworkWalkDatTests) and the sizing (0.02 a cast at the worst case, 25.1 an hour at about 1,250 casts; keep 100 is 4 hours, a stop at most every 2 h 23 min) are tusker-cave.json's town_stock line of the same ware. It replaces the carried stock line of this profile (keep 20, trip_under = stop_under = 2): a carried line under its stop line stops the run by name (LogisticsCounters, the stock stop), no catalog seller lists the Gold Scarab (BuyTripRule: no-seller, TODO(m6-buy-trip-seller)), and the ladder's character, never granted anything, would have stopped at this rung's door as she did at the Temple 20-40 on 2026-11-12. The spell plan's level V row stays: the profile loader, GearKit.CastBurns and FightScenario.WarKitCarries take a town stock line for a plan component (HuntingGround.TownStockOf); a pack with none casts level IV on the Silver Scarab line.

town_stock.name: Pyreal Scarab
town_stock.source: M6 item 14 (m6-goldscarab): the Pyreal Scarab 690 of level VI at the same counter, 1,550 pyreals: sourced and sized in tusker-cave.json's town_stock line of the same ware (0.03 a cast at the worst case; keep 100 is 2 h 40 min, a stop at most every 96 minutes); not bought before the book holds a level VI spell. No plan row of this profile casts level VI; the line serves the heals, the drains and the buffs her skill reaches. M6 14 (the owner, 2026-11-13: the Temple 20-40 leaves the ladder, the Cave to 39, the Abode from 40; the Abode's kit to the Cave's standard): the level up job's fight casts Flame Bolt VI here when her live War Magic lands it at 0.95 (the ladder's live cap, FightOptions.LiveCap; the buff bot's War Magic of about 297 to 301 at level 40 does), so the line serves the bolt too, and the components list level VI's formulas.

fight.source: M6 14 (the owner, 2026-11-13: the Temple 20-40 leaves the ladder, the Cave to 39, the Abode from 40; the Abode's kit to the Cave's standard), as the Cave's (tusker-cave.json fight, M6 7 AX: fight null gave no pull rest and no full-bar rule, and the retreat fell to the autopilot's default floor of 50). pull_full_percent 100, pull_health_percent 70, pull_rest_posture lie, pull_rest_potions 1, pull_potion_mana_percent 75 and pull_potion_stamina_percent 15: the Cave's, the owner's rules (M6 7 AN; M6 8, 2026-11-11). pull_aggro_metres 20: VisualAwarenessRange (PropertyFloat 31) of Tusker Redeemer 22520, 22600 and 22601, SELECT object_Id, value FROM weenie_properties_float WHERE type = 31 on the world copy, 2026-11-13 (the Crimsonback's is 24). pull_mana_percent 100: a Redeemer has 250 health and Magic Defense 171 (targets); at War Magic 297 (the buff bot's, level 38, 2026-11-12) a bolt lands at 0.978 (SkillCheck.GetSkillChance, factor 0.03, SkillCheck.cs:19-22 @95ef426d); a landed Flame Bolt V is uniform on 68 to 136 and VI on 84 to 168 (the spell table's base_Intensity and variance, WarSpellPicker.Rows) plus the picker's skill bonus (WarSpellPicker.MeanHit: base x (skill - power) / 1000, 6.6 and 3.9), so a kill takes 2.88 landed V or 2.39 landed VI, 2.94 or 2.44 casts, at the spell table's base mana of 25 and 30 (SpellTableData, Flame Bolt V 84 and VI 85): 74 mana a Redeemer at either level, before Mana Conversion. The pack: the median of the 37 slots the walk reaches is 4 Redeemers within 20 m on their floor (SELECT guid, obj_Cell_Id, origin_X, origin_Y, origin_Z FROM landblock_instance WHERE landblock = 0x5C45 AND weenie_Class_Id IN (22520, 22600, 22601), the slots of the tour's cells, |dz| 3 m or less; distance and height only, no cell visibility: an upper bound, as the Cave's read; max 6), so a pull is 296 and two drains at 10 more, 316 of the pool of 323 (levels 35 to 37, the live log of 2026-11-12, war-mage.json sources.vitals): 98%, rounded up to 100. pull_rest_until_percent 100: at least the mana's floor (GroundCatalog refuses a rest that ends under a floor). retreat_health_percent 45, not the Cave's 40: the way out is Lifestone Recall (the exit portal lies on the lower level no walk reaches, exit.source, TODO(m6-abode-lower-level)); the Cave's live hits of 2026-11-11 (886 hits, 8 to 11.6 health a second with a pack on her, tusker-cave.json sources.supplies) scaled by the Redeemer's hit 82 over the Crimsonback's 65 (war-mage.json abode health) are 10.1 to 14.6 a second, and about 4 s to leave (the Cave's) cost 40 to 58; at the projected 136 health of level 40 (ClimberHealthRule.ProjectedBuy, ClimberHealthRuleTests) 58 is 43%, rounded up to 45, under the ladder's drain line of 50 (vitals.drain_under_percent), so the drain acts first. A second retreat in a cycle stops the run by name (retreat:again, D68). The Redeemer's swing is not drafted (TODO(f11-swing-seconds)). All planning values: nothing has been fought here, TODO(m6-abode-fight-live).
